facts_found: Before ordering a replacement credit card the agent must verify the customer's identity, look up the credit card account, confirm the shipping address (primary or alternate, including unit/suite), record exactly one replacement reason, ask about expedited shipping with tier-based fee advice, and confirm replacement eligibility before unlocking or calling the tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The replacement tool workflow is: unlock order_replacement_credit_card_7291 with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool, then call it with call_discoverable_agent_tool supplying the credit card account identifier (account_id or card_id from the account lookup), Reason, Shipping_address, Shipping_speed, Expedited_fee_acknowledgement (consent captured if a fee applies by tier), and Notes (e.g., travel dates, fraud report reference, delivery instructions). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]
Standard credit card replacement delivery is 7–10 business days and free for all cardholders; expedited delivery is 2–3 business days. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

Expedited shipping fees by tier: Entry-tier (Bronze Rewards, EcoCard, Business Bronze) $15.00; Mid-tier (Silver Rewards, Business Silver, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) $10.00; Premium-tier and above (Gold Rewards, Business Gold, Platinum, Business Platinum, Diamond Elite) $0.00 complimentary. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

If the replacement reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, expedited shipping is strongly recommended to reduce the window for potential misuse, and the customer should be reminded to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]
After the replacement order is submitted, the old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The replacement creates a new card with a different card number and CVV; the account number is unchanged so recurring payments continue, but saved card details with merchants must be updated after the new card arrives. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]
The customer receives an email when the replacement order is placed and another when the card ships; activation instructions accompany the new card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

Replacement requests are rejected if there is already a pending replacement request on the account (wait until it is delivered or cancelled), or if the tier replacement limit within a 60-day period is exceeded: Entry-tier 2, Mid-tier 3, Premium-tier and above 4. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_004]

Outstanding replacement orders can be checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765, called with the credit_card_account_id parameter; order records include order_id, status (pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled), created_at, latest_event_at and notes. After the replacement order is submitted, the old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The replacement creates a new card with a different card number and CVV; the account number is unchanged so recurring payments continue, but saved card details with merchants must be updated after the new card arrives. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

The customer receives an email when the replacement order is placed and another when the card ships; activation instructions accompany the new card. [source: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_003]

facts_found: Outstanding replacement orders can be checked with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765, called with the credit_card_account_id parameter; order records include order_id, status (pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled), created_at, latest_event_at and notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_005]

After a fraud_suspected or stolen replacement, the agent must remind the customer to review recent transactions and dispute unauthorized charges in the app or website, and must document the interaction and replacement order details in the customer record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001]

The dispute tool's card_action value 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the card is being cancelled and a replacement issued, whether the replacement was already ordered via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation happens as part of the dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
Credit card accounts cannot be closed while a replacement card order is pending (the replacement must be delivered or the order cancelled). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001]

get_credit_card_accounts_by_user retrieves all credit card accounts (active and closed) for a customer and can be used to obtain the credit card account identifier. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030]

get_user_dispute_history_7291 is the internal tool that retrieves a user's credit card dispute history; it is called with the user's user_id and returns a list of all credit card disputes filed by that user. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Each dispute record returned by get_user_dispute_history_7291 includes dispute_id, dispute_date, status (open, under_review, closed), last_updated_at, transaction details (transaction_id, transaction_date, merchant_name, amount, currency, card_last4), and, when available, reason_code, outcome and internal notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

get_user_dispute_history_7291 returns only credit card disputes associated with the specified user_id; an empty result set means the user has filed no credit card disputes or the user_id is incorrect. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

The provisional credit 'Previous Disputes' criterion requires that the customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; use dispute_date from the dispute history to assess recency. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

All five provisional credit criteria must be true for eligibility: account open at least 60 days; qualifying dispute reason; amount at least $25.00 and not exceeding the card tier maximum; not more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; and merchant contacted first for non-fraud disputes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

eligible_for_provisional_credit is argument 15 of file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829, a boolean the agent must determine from the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines and pass as true or false. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 must first be unlocked and then called via call_discoverable_agent_tool with a JSON string of all required arguments (including transaction_id, card_action, card_last_4_digits, full_name, user_id, phone, email, address, contacted_merchant, purchase_date, issue_noticed_date, dispute_reason, resolution_requested, and eligible_for_provisional_credit). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

The debit card dispute history tool get_debit_dispute_status_7483(user_id) is a different tool for debit card disputes and is not the credit card dispute history tool. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_035]
get_card_last_4_digits(credit_card_account_id) can supply the card_last_4_digits argument required by the dispute tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_013]

Step 0 requires verifying the requested increase is within the card tier's maximum BEFORE submitting; a request exceeding the tier limit must not be submitted - the customer is told the maximum and asked to adjust. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392 is called with credit_card_account_id, user_id, and requested_increase_amount (integer dollar amount of the increase, not the new total); it creates the formal record before eligibility checks, which are internal and not exposed to customers. Step 2 post-submission eligibility checks (all must be checked for complete audit records): account age minimum for tier, cooldown period via get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829, no pending disputes, no pending replacement cards, account good standing (current, no past-due balance), and credit utilization below the tier maximum. If a replacement card order is pending on the account, the CLI cannot be processed until the replacement is delivered or cancelled. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

Premium-tier CLI thresholds: minimum account age 60 days, cooldown between requests 60 days, maximum utilization at request 90% (must be below, not at, 90%). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
Cooldown applies only if the most recent CLI request was approved; denied requests do not trigger a cooldown period. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]

[doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]
